observed_result: All 20 matching top-level tests/examples passed on Mac and Ubuntu from the identical 127-file source snapshot. Input and output projections round-trip with coefficients, selection provenance, ordered neuron IDs/hash and dimensions. Explicit, cell-type and region selection plus fixed-seed random coefficients reconstruct deterministically. Binding resolves changed graph index order and rejects missing/duplicate cells, changed selected metadata, incompatible shape/direction, malformed core parameters, null numeric values and corrupt hashes. Compact input selection matches a dense expansion for predictions and all gradient groups; finite differences cover core weights/bias/tau, encoder, readout and observations. Replacement preserves the supplied core, leaves the old trainer untouched and initializes a new optimizer. A checkpoint with selected input nodes resumes in a genuinely separate process to exactly the uninterrupted parameters, optimizer and predictions. Default nil InputNodes preserves legacy configuration JSON. Full module/build/test/race/vet/CLI restore checks passed on both platforms; Windows crosscompilation passed. Metadata-selected neuron lists with noncanonical order now fail during decoding even with a matching hash. Signal decoding rejects invalid UTF-8 and unpaired UTF-16 escapes before Go can replace them, including legacy Signal/Mapping/NeuronID paths. NeuronID builders/marshaling reject invalid UTF-8; valid replacement runes, surrogate pairs and literal escaped backslashes retain their values.
limitations: Artificial graph fixture; no biological mapping efficacy, whole-brain training, GPU execution or Windows runtime claim.
Candidates must be supplied in the actual dynamics graph index order. Framework validates consistency against that supplied identity/metadata list, not independent biological provenance.
Projection neuron hash covers ordered IDs only; it is not a checksum of coefficients or the whole graph.
Replacing projections replaces both encoder and readout with the supplied coefficients and starts a fresh optimizer. Trained projection coefficients must be explicitly exported from a snapshot.
JSON limits are 16 MiB/depth 64; candidate/selected neurons and coefficients each have a 1,048,576 count limit. These are not process RSS bounds.
Input/output channel rank is checked via ValidateChannelShape before flattening; BindProjections checks the model channel widths.
